subject: Every string the arrange.regions surface exposes to AX in it-IT
question: What labels does Logic show on arrange.regions in it-IT, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in it-IT whose arrange.regions rows carry the same 3 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: Inizio regione: 1 misura ; fine regione: 2 misure

conclusion: On this host in it-IT, arrange.regions exposes 2 elements carrying 3 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.
288 window rows matched no surface rule and are not filed under any record; they are in the evidence file and can be re-classified when a rule exists.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.

canon.used_for: a label this surface exposes to AX, read verbatim from the census; cited so the string is Apple's and not one that was typed
